diagnosis: A representation action is not uniformly safe across natural environments, and a single positive Support response can falsely confirm transport to the current evaluation cohort. Add bounded transport evidence before ordering or execution while retaining supported representation actions.
expected_behavior_change: Positive Support is no longer sufficient by itself to authorize transport; useful representation actions remain available when current support and pre-cutoff contextual transport evidence agree.
falsification_condition: Deterministic local replay accepts a representation after a positive current Support probe despite pre-cutoff historical transport evidence that is discordant with the current context.

observation_requirements.name: training-visible context compatibility
observation_requirements.scope: Observe the current training-visible period bucket and baseline-fit context without dataset identity.

observation_requirements.name: historical support transport consistency
observation_requirements.scope: Observe whether prior phase-aligned policy episodes ending before the current Query cutoff show support transport consistent with the current context, without dataset identity.

observation_requirements.name: current target support status
observation_requirements.scope: Observe the current Target Support label for the candidate representation without reading the Query future.

risk_guards: ABSTAIN when current Target Support is CONTRAINDICATED_OR_UNRESOLVED.
ABSTAIN when historical phase-aligned transport evidence is absent or discordant with the current training-visible context.
ABSTAIN when the decision would require current Query future information.

workflow_steps.behavior: Bind the candidate decision to training-visible context only.
Check prior action-response transport evidence ending before the current Query cutoff.
Read the current support label for the candidate representation.
Order supported representation actions only when transport evidence is present and non-discordant; otherwise include ABSTAIN.
Execute the selected representation program only after the bounded observation checks pass.
